local function verifyFragmentObservation(s)
 assert(s.fragments==120 and s.observedFragments==120,'all 120 launched fragments must be observed')
 assert(s.serverOwned==120 and s.ownershipFailures==0,'all fragments must stay server owned')
 assert(s.anchoredFailures==0,'launched fragments must remain physical')
 assert(s.postSimulationSteps>=2 and s.postSimulationReads>=240 and s.minPostReads>=2,'at least two complete physics observations required')
 assert(s.maxSpeed>=30 and s.postSimulationMaxSpeed>=30,'actual simulated launch speed must reach 30 studs per second')
 assert(s.fastFragmentsMoved>=1 and s.fastMaxDisplacement>=0.1,'a fast simulated fragment must actually move')
 assert(not s.timedOut and not s.sampleCapReached,'bounded launch observation was incomplete')
 assert(s.observationError=='','physics observer failed: '..s.observationError)
end

local function startFragmentObservation(folder,runService)
 local state={records={},observedFragments=0,postSimulationSteps=0,postSimulationReads=0,
  immediateMaxSpeed=0,deferredMaxSpeed=0,postSimulationMaxSpeed=0,maxSpeed=0,
  fastMaxDisplacement=0,ownershipFailures=0,anchoredFailures=0,observationError='',trace={}}
 local started=os.clock() local stopped=false local addedConnection,stepConnection,timeoutThread
 local function stop()
  if stopped then return end stopped=true
  if addedConnection then addedConnection:Disconnect() end
  if stepConnection then stepConnection:Disconnect() end
  if timeoutThread and coroutine.running()~=timeoutThread then pcall(task.cancel,timeoutThread) end
 end
 local function sample(part,kind)
  if stopped or not part:IsA('BasePart') or part.Parent~=folder then return end
  local t=os.clock()-started local r=state.records[part]
  if not r then
   r={origin=part.Position,firstAt=t,fast=false,maxDisplacement=0,postReads=0}
   state.records[part]=r state.observedFragments+=1
   if not state.firstFragmentAt then state.firstFragmentAt=t end
  end
  local speed=part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
  assert(speed==speed and speed<math.huge,'non-finite actual fragment velocity')
  local owned,owner=pcall(function() return part:GetNetworkOwner() end)
  -- ChildAdded may run before production SetNetworkOwner(nil); judge ownership after initialization.
  if kind~='FirstObserved' and (not owned or owner~=nil) then state.ownershipFailures+=1 end
  if part.Anchored then state.anchoredFailures+=1 end
  local moved=(part.Position-r.origin).Magnitude r.maxDisplacement=math.max(r.maxDisplacement,moved)
  if kind=='PostSimulation' then
   r.postReads+=1 state.postSimulationReads+=1
   if speed>state.postSimulationMaxSpeed then
    state.postSimulationMaxSpeed=speed state.peakAt=t state.peakFragment=part.Name
   end
   if speed>=30 then r.fast=true end
   if r.fast then state.fastMaxDisplacement=math.max(state.fastMaxDisplacement,moved) end
  elseif kind=='DeferredAfterAdd' then state.deferredMaxSpeed=math.max(state.deferredMaxSpeed,speed)
  else state.immediateMaxSpeed=math.max(state.immediateMaxSpeed,speed) end
  state.maxSpeed=math.max(state.maxSpeed,speed)
 end
 local function safely(fn)
  local ok,err=pcall(fn) if not ok then state.observationError=tostring(err) stop() end
 end
 addedConnection=folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(part)
  safely(function() sample(part,'FirstObserved') end)
  task.defer(function() safely(function() sample(part,'DeferredAfterAdd') end) end)
 end)
 stepConnection=runService.PostSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
  if stopped then return end
  safely(function()
   if state.postSimulationSteps>=240 then state.sampleCapReached=true stop() return end
   local children=folder:GetChildren()
   if #children>0 then
    state.postSimulationSteps+=1
    for _,part in ipairs(children) do sample(part,'PostSimulation') end
    local point={t=os.clock()-started,dt=dt,parts=#children,peak=state.postSimulationMaxSpeed,moved=state.fastMaxDisplacement}
    if #state.trace<5 then table.insert(state.trace,point) end state.lastStep=point
   end
  end)
 end)
 timeoutThread=task.delay(2,function() state.timedOut=true stop() end)
 local observation={Stop=stop}
 function observation:Finish()
  stop()
  local final=folder:GetChildren() local owned,maxInitial,fastMoved,minPostReads=0,0,0,math.huge
  for _,part in ipairs(final) do
   assert(part:IsA('BasePart'),'unexpected nonphysical fragment')
   local ok,owner=pcall(function() return part:GetNetworkOwner() end)
   if ok and owner==nil then owned+=1 end
   if part.Anchored then state.anchoredFailures+=1 end
   maxInitial=math.max(maxInitial,part:GetAttribute('InitialForwardSpeed') or 0)
  end
  for _,r in pairs(state.records) do minPostReads=math.min(minPostReads,r.postReads) if r.fast and r.postReads>=2 and r.maxDisplacement>=0.1 then fastMoved+=1 end end
  state.records=nil state.fragments=#final state.serverOwned=owned state.maxInitial=maxInitial
  state.fastFragmentsMoved=fastMoved state.minPostReads=minPostReads<math.huge and minPostReads or 0 state.elapsed=os.clock()-started
  state.timedOut=state.timedOut==true state.sampleCapReached=state.sampleCapReached==true
  return state
 end
 return observation
end

local function runObservedPunch(command,folder,runService)
 local observation=startFragmentObservation(folder,runService)
 local returnedAt
 local ok,result=xpcall(function()
  local result=command:Invoke('PunchRadius') returnedAt=os.clock()
  task.wait(0.15) return result
 end,debug.traceback)
 observation:Stop()
 if not ok then error(result) end
 local summary=observation:Finish()
 summary.returnToReadSeconds=os.clock()-returnedAt
 local valid,why=pcall(verifyFragmentObservation,summary)
 if not valid then error(('%s [max=%.4f post=%.4f moved=%.4f steps=%d reads=%d elapsed=%.3f timeout=%s cap=%s]'):format(
  tostring(why),summary.maxSpeed,summary.postSimulationMaxSpeed,summary.fastMaxDisplacement,
  summary.postSimulationSteps,summary.postSimulationReads,summary.elapsed,tostring(summary.timedOut),tostring(summary.sampleCapReached))) end
 return result,summary
end

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local R=game:GetService('RunService')
local players=game.Players:GetPlayers() local root=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG')) local storage=game:GetService('ServerStorage')
assert(R:IsStudio() and #players==1 and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio'
 and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false
 and storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'strict ephemeral fixture required')
local p=players[1]
assert(p:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and p:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio'
 and p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'ready non-writable ephemeral profile required')
local c=storage.PunchWallAutomation
assert(c:Invoke('Reset').ok==true,'Reset failed')
assert(c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=1500000000,WallLevel=99,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}).ok==true,'SetStats failed')
local hrp=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart hrp.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-20),Vector3.new(-2,3,-200)) p:SetAttribute('LastWallHit',0)
local r,s=runObservedPunch(c,root['Depth Physics Debris'],R)
local out={ok=r.ok,outcome=r.outcome,requested=p:GetAttribute('LastPunchRequestedDistance'),travel=p:GetAttribute('LastPunchLungeDistance'),
 scale=p:GetAttribute('LastPunchPowerScale'),limit=p:GetAttribute('LastPunchPenetrationLimit'),force=p:GetAttribute('LastPunchImpactForceScale'),
 hit=p:GetAttribute('LastRadiusHitCount'),broken=r.BrokenDepthBlocks,fragments=s.fragments,maxSpeed=s.maxSpeed,maxInitial=s.maxInitial,serverOwned=s.serverOwned,
 observedPhysicalLaunch=true,observation=s}
print('PENETRATION_OBSERVATION '..H:JSONEncode(out))
return H:JSONEncode(out)
